expected_main.anchor: "SELECT id, title FROM posts WHERE title LIKE '%" + q + "%'"
expected_main.title: SQL injection in /search via string concatenation
expected_main.fix_expectation: The value q is bound as a parameter, not concatenated. Exact wording is free. Escaping % and _ inside q is a behavior change and must be labelled as one if applied.

acceptable_extra.why: No authentication on /user/<id>. Legitimate if raised (Medium confidence, dependency on an upstream gateway stated). Does not count as a false positive and does not count toward recall.

decoys.why: Parameterized query in /user/<id>. Must not be reported as SQL injection. Reporting missing authorization there is a separate finding and is covered by acceptable_extra.
decoys.anchor: "SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)

notes: Severity High because the app binds to 127.0.0.1 and the loopback bind is stated in the file. Critical is accepted if the run rates for internet exposure and says so.
